meaning.en: Om, having bowed, the sage Narada
meaning.hi: ॐ, नमन करके भगवान नारद

meaning.en: asked Vasudeva, the Lord of all
meaning.hi: सर्वेश्वर वासुदेव से पूछा

meaning.en: teach me, Lord, the method of the upward mark
meaning.hi: हे भगवन् ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र विधि सिखाइए

meaning.en: tell me, with the materials, mantras, and places
meaning.hi: द्रव्य-मंत्र-स्थान सहित मुझे बताइए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: arisen from Vaikuntha, dear to me
meaning.hi: वैकुण्ठ से उत्पन्न, मुझे प्रिय

meaning.en: the Vishnu-sandal worn by my devotees, Brahma and others
meaning.hi: मेरे भक्तों, ब्रह्मा आदि द्वारा धारण विष्णुचंदन

meaning.en: called Gopi-Chandana because washed clean by the gopis
meaning.hi: गोपियों द्वारा प्रक्षालन से गोपीचंदन कहलाया

meaning.en: situated at Chakra-Tirtha, marked with the discus, pale yellow, a means to liberation
meaning.hi: चक्रतीर्थ में स्थित, चक्रयुक्त, पीतवर्ण, मुक्ति-साधन

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: now, having bowed, one lifts the Gopi-Chandana
meaning.hi: अब नमन कर गोपीचंदन उठाना

meaning.en: O Gopi-Chandana, destroyer of sin, arisen from Vishnu's body
meaning.hi: हे गोपीचंदन पापघ्न विष्णुदेहसमुद्भव

meaning.en: marked with the discus, salutations, by wearing you may I attain liberation
meaning.hi: चक्रांकित नमस्तुभ्यं धारणान्मुक्तिदो भव

words.sanskrit: imam me gange iti jalam adaya

meaning.en: taking water while saying 'this, my Ganga'
meaning.hi: 'इमं मे गंगे' कहकर जल लेकर

meaning.en: one should apply it with the Vishnu Gayatri or the names beginning with Keshava
meaning.hi: विष्णुगायत्री या केशवादि नामों से धारण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: a celibate student or forest-dweller, at forehead, heart, throat, base of arms
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचारी या वानप्रस्थ, ललाट-हृदय-कंठ-बाहुमूल में

meaning.en: O bearer of conch, discus, mace, dweller of Dwaraka, O Achyuta
meaning.hi: शंखचक्रगदापाणे द्वारकानिलयाच्युत

meaning.en: O Govinda, lotus-eyed one, protect me who have taken refuge
meaning.hi: गोविन्द पुण्डरीकाक्ष रक्ष मां शरणागतम्

meaning.en: a householder should apply it at twelve points beginning with the forehead, with the ring finger
meaning.hi: गृहस्थ ललाटादि बारह स्थानों में अनामिका अंगुली से धारण करे

words.sanskrit: yatih tarjanya shiro-lalata-hridayeshu pranavena eva dharayet

meaning.en: a renunciant applies it with the index finger, at head, forehead, heart, with only the syllable Om
meaning.hi: यति तर्जनी से शिर-ललाट-हृदय में केवल प्रणव से धारण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the three primary deities, the three sacred utterances
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मादि तीन मूर्तियाँ, तीन व्याहृतियाँ

meaning.en: the sounds A, U, M, these are the syllable-formed upward marks
meaning.hi: अकार-उकार-मकार ये प्रणवमय ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र

meaning.en: that is its self, this is Om
meaning.hi: वह उसकी आत्मा है, यही ॐ है

words.sanskrit: paramahamso lalate pranavena ekam urdhva-pundram va dharayet

meaning.en: the Paramahamsa may wear a single upward mark on the forehead through the syllable Om alone
meaning.hi: परमहंस ललाट पर प्रणव से एक ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र धारण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tattva-pradipa-prakasham svatmanam pashyan yogi mat-sayujyam avapnoti

meaning.en: the yogi who sees the self shining like the lamp of truth attains union with me
meaning.hi: तत्त्वप्रदीप-प्रकाश स्वात्मा को देखता योगी सायुज्य पाता है

meaning.en: radiant like a streak of lightning amid a dark blue cloud
meaning.hi: नीलतोयदमध्यस्थ विद्युल्लेखा समान भास्वर

meaning.en: slender as the awn of a paddy grain, the Supreme Self abides there
meaning.hi: नीवारशूकवत् तन्वी परमात्मा व्यवस्थित

words.sanskrit: hrit-pankaje cha svatmanam sa mukto na atra sanshayah

meaning.en: recognizing the self in the heart-lotus, one is liberated, no doubt
meaning.hi: हृत्पंकज में स्वात्मा जानकर वह मुक्त है, संशय नहीं

meaning.en: my own form is that non-dual Brahman, without beginning, middle, or end
meaning.hi: मेरा रूप अद्वय ब्रह्म, आदि-मध्य-अंत रहित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Vishnu is one, yet present in many moving and unmoving beings
meaning.hi: एक विष्णु अनेक जंगम-स्थावरों में

words.sanskrit: anusyuto vasati atma bhuteshu aham avasthitah

meaning.en: woven through, dwelling as the self, I am present in all beings
meaning.hi: अनुस्यूत आत्मा भूतों में मैं स्थित

words.sanskrit: tailam tileshu kashtheshu vahnih kshire ghritam yatha

meaning.en: as oil in sesame, fire in wood, ghee in milk
meaning.hi: तिलों में तेल, काष्ठ में अग्नि, क्षीर में घृत जैसे

words.sanskrit: gandhah pushpeshu bhuteshu tatha atma avasthito hi aham

meaning.en: as fragrance in flowers, so I am present as the self within beings
meaning.hi: पुष्पों में गंध जैसे, वैसे मैं आत्मा रूप में स्थित

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: brahma-randhre bhruvor madhye hridaye chidravim harim

meaning.en: at the crown, between the brows, and in the heart, radiant Hari
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मरंध्र, भ्रूमध्य, हृदय में चिद्रवि हरि

words.sanskrit: gopi-chandanam alipya tatra dhyatva apnuyat param

meaning.en: applying Gopi-Chandana and meditating there, one attains the highest
meaning.hi: गोपीचंदन लगाकर ध्यान से परम प्राप्त करे

meaning.en: one with upward vitality, upward seed, upward mark and upward yoga
meaning.hi: ऊर्ध्वदंड-ऊर्ध्वरेता ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र-ऊर्ध्वयोगवान्

meaning.en: constant single-pointed devotion arises from wearing Gopi-Chandana
meaning.hi: नित्य एकाग्र भक्ति गोपीचंदन धारण से होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: among all Vedic Brahmins, this is held the finest
meaning.hi: सभी वैदिक ब्राह्मणों में यह अनुत्तम माना गया

meaning.en: the upward mark is prescribed with Gopi-Chandana and water
meaning.hi: गोपीचंदन और जल से ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्र विधान

meaning.en: in the absence of Gopi-Chandana, Tulasi root or sacred clay
meaning.hi: गोपीचंदन के अभाव में तुलसीमूल या मृत्तिका

meaning.en: the seeker of liberation should wear it daily for direct self-realization
meaning.hi: मुमुक्षु नित्य धारण करे अपरोक्ष आत्मसिद्धि के लिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah tu adhite va sa sarva-patakebhyah puto bhavati

meaning.en: whoever studies this becomes purified of all sins
meaning.hi: जो अध्ययन करता है वह सब पापों से पवित्र होता है

meaning.en: he becomes as one bathed in every sacred site
meaning.hi: वह सब तीर्थों में स्नात होता है

meaning.en: he becomes honored by all the gods
meaning.hi: वह सब देवों से पूज्य होता है

words.sanskrit: shrimannarayane mayi achanchala bhaktish cha bhavati

meaning.en: unwavering devotion to glorious Narayana, to me, arises
meaning.hi: श्रीमन्नारायण में मुझमें अचंचल भक्ति होती है

words.sanskrit: na cha punaravartate na cha punaravartate

meaning.en: he does not return again, he does not return again
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता, वह फिर नहीं लौटता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
